name: openbb_equity_fundamental_ratios
description:
Financial ratios for one company over several periods (valuation, profitability, liquidity such as current and quick ratio, leverage) through the OpenBB Platform (obb.equity.fundamental.ratios).
Returns: {tool, data_points (total rows), data: first 100 rows as OpenBB returns them} or {tool, error}.
Inputs (* required): symbol*; provider (OpenBB 4.6 accepts fmp or intrinio; schema default fmp, but when omitted the tool sends yfinance, which this command rejects, so set it).
Headline metrics: openbb_equity_metrics; without a key: yf_stock_info. Keys: fmp, benzinga, fred, intrinio, polygon and tiingo need credentials in OpenBB's settings (~/.openbb_platform/user_settings.json), not supplied by SAJHA; yfinance, oecd, federal_reserve, sec, imf and government_us need none.
Example: {"symbol": "AAPL", "provider": "fmp"}
